name: Kára
personality: Befitting of her status as the wandering NPC legendary, Kára is a very easygoing individual who seems more interested in the journey rather than the result at the end. It’s hard to tell if she wants the world to go back to how it was before, or if she wants to find some middle ground between the current state of the world and the old days. Either way, she’s here to help! Somehow...!

abilities.name: Flying
abilities.description: Can fly around, and tolerate difficult flying conditions like hailstorms, sandstorms, or similar.

abilities.name: Creator and Master
abilities.description: Kára can control mechanical/golem-like creations to make them do simplistic things akin to basic motions. For sentient beings that fit this category, they must be unconscious and their player must allow what Kára makes them do. She cannot control the person, only the physical form.

abilities.name: Skill Link
abilities.description: Maximizes the number of times multi-strike moves hit.

abilities.name: Overclock
abilities.description: If Kára’s speed is not raised, she can still act twice within a single turn, but will inflict Burn on herself in consequence after the forced extra action. Kára automatically cures herself of any Burn status if she does not force an extra action in her turn.

abilities.name: Miniregi
abilities.description: Kára can no longer actively use Spike Cannon in battle. Instead, the miniregi buddy will automatically use it on a random enemy every time she uses a move (scaling off her stat changes and PP), but it only deals 10% of its original damage.

moves.name: Spike Cannon
moves.description: Sharp spikes are shot at the target in rapid succession. They hit two to five times in a row.

moves.name: Tickle
moves.description: The user tickles the foe into laughing, reducing its Attack and Defense stats.

moves.name: Defog
moves.description: A strong wind blows away the target's barriers such as Reflect or Light Screen. This also lowers the target's evasiveness.

moves.name: Imprison
moves.description: Prevents target from using moves known by the user.

moves.name: Teleport
moves.description: The user teleports to another location within the current island, which can be a few feet.

moves.name: Crush Grip
moves.description: The target is crushed with great force. The more HP the target has left, the greater the move’s power.

moves.name: Atomization
moves.description: The target is compressed with strong pressure. The less HP the target has left, the greater the move’s power.

backstory:
Regigigas, the great, renown creator of the regis, parent to their creations of steel, ice, stone, thunder, and dragon, simply awoke one day to the curious feeling of...
Weightlessness. A cloudlike fluff, even. A tinge of immaturity in the back of her mind.
She was in the mind of a young, adventurous youth. 
She was as free as she could ever be. With simply the thought of momentum, she could soar into the skies and move around with ease. 
To the past with those old, rusty limbs of hers that took ages to get here and there!
To the past!
...
It was still wrong.
Things weren’t the same anymore.
Something was different.
...
What had she been before this?
Who was Kára?
